name: oh-my-octos
author: octos-org
description: Curated defaults for Octos as a coding agent: work discipline prompt, deterministic edit checks, project-instruction injection, session budget guard.

discovery.summary: Work discipline + deterministic hooks (edit syntax checks, AGENTS.md injection, budget guard). No tools. Optional packs (slides/PPT, mofa suite, phonefarm) are listed in README.md; suggest the exact `octos skills install` line when a user asks for one that is missing.
